subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu streaming card full-content updates cause severe latency regression on long replies

question: Should Feishu streaming cards add an explicit opt-in append/delta payload mode for tenants where full accumulated CardKit updates cause severe long-reply latency?
rationale: The repository has a high bar for new config surface, and the prior full-content fix prevents truncation in other Feishu setups, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent payload contract.

options.title: Add Opt-In Append Mode
options.body: Keep full-content updates as the default but add a documented Feishu plugin-local opt-in append/delta mode with regression tests and live proof for both truncation and latency.

options.title: Full-Content Only Investigation
options.body: Reject append mode for now and require deeper Feishu/CardKit proof of a full-content transport fix before changing config or defaults.

options.title: Fold Into Broad Reliability Tracker
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability work and avoid a separate latency-specific mode until the buffer model is redesigned.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Append Mode
recommendation.body: Keep full-content updates as the default but add a documented Feishu plugin-local opt-in append/delta mode with regression tests and live proof for both truncation and latency.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu plugin community contact, and the decision is Feishu plugin behavior rather than core runtime policy.
